title: Weekly Wrap 849: How much wood could a wood duck duck? – Stilgherrian
text:
Stilgherrian

Word-whore. I write 'em. I talk 'em. Information, politics, media, and the cybers. I drink. I use bad words. All publication is a political act. All communication is propaganda. All art is pornography. All business is personal. All hail Eris! Vive les poissons rouges sauvages!

How about five of them? Quack! My week of Monday 31 August to Sunday 6 September 2026 was a mixed bag of naps and minor victories. I had hoped to get a lot more planning and organising done, but there was a lot more to sort through than I’d estimated. It was stressful.

On the weekend I went to one of the nearby clubs and won a tray of barramundi, so there will be a couple of fish dinners coming up soon. However, there’s no more news of The Lost Module since my update last week.

None of these this week. You can subscribe to my YouTube channel to be notified when new videos appear and when the occasional livestreams are scheduled.

It’s yet another week of small pieces. Client work, podcast planning, administrivia, all manner of errands — and I’ll also be pushing this season’s crowdfunder now that spring is definitely with us.

NEW: On Thursday I’m kicking off the spring series recordings of The 9pm Edict podcast with our South-East Asia correspondent Erin Cook. If you’re a supporter with TRIGGER WORDS or a CONVERSATION TOPIC for this episode, please let me know by 2pm AEST this Thursday 10 September.

The Weekly Cybers newsletter will appear on Friday afternoon as usual. The Erin Cook podcast will probably be edited and posted on Sunday.

[Update 13 September 2026: Or probably not. I’ll be having a relaxing Sunday instead. Indeed, I’m adding this tag well after midday.]

[Photo: Five Australian wood ducks (Chenonetta jubata) photographed in Bowral on 23 August 2026.]
